about: Dated facts and quotations used on the steps of the story 'Beyond UPI: everything else India pays with' (src/app/stories/beyond-upi). Each is from a Reserve Bank of India or Government of India page, read on 15-10-2026; 'quote' is copied from it, and 'note' says only what the source says. 'slide' names the step it is shown on; 'day' is the date the change took effect, 'issued' the date of the document. data/processors/story-beyond-upi.mjs checks each date and each link.

events.label: RTGS goes live
events.note: The RBI's RTGS system went live on 26 March 2004, at first for payments between banks only.
events.source_title: RTGS Services now for Bank Customers: RBI
events.quote: the Reserve Bank of India's Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) System went live on March 26, 2004. Initially, it was open to the settlement of inter-bank transactions.

events.label: RTGS round the clock
events.note: RTGS became available round the clock, every day of the year, from 00:30 hours on 14 December 2020.
events.source_title: RBI announces date for launching of RTGS 24x7
events.quote: RTGS 24x7x365 will be launched with effect from 00:30 hours on December 14, 2020.

events.label: Credit within 30 minutes
events.note: The RBI's RTGS FAQ, read on 15-10-2026: the receiving bank must credit the account within 30 minutes of receiving the transfer message.
events.source_title: RBI, Frequently asked questions on RTGS, question 13
events.quote: The beneficiary bank must credit the beneficiary's account within 30 minutes of receiving the fund transfer message.

events.label: NEFT round the clock, in 48 batches
events.note: NEFT became available round the clock from 16 December 2019, settling in 48 half-hourly batches a day.
events.source_title: Availability of National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT) System on 24x7 basis (RBI/2019-20/111)
events.quote: There will be 48 half-hourly batches every day.

events.label: CTS required at every branch
events.note: The RBI required banks to bring all their branches into image-based cheque truncation (CTS) by 30 September 2021.
events.source_title: Extension of Cheque Truncation System (CTS) across all bank branches in the country (RBI/2020-21/107)
events.quote: ensure that all their branches participate in image-based CTS

events.label: Every toll lane a FASTag lane
events.note: All lanes at national-highway fee plazas were declared FASTag lanes from the midnight of 15/16 February 2021.
events.source_title: FASTag declared mandatory from midnight tomorrow (Ministry of Road Transport and Highways)
events.quote: all lanes in the fee plazas on National Highways shall be declared as "FASTag lane of the fee plaza" w.e.f midnight of 15th/16th February 2021

events.label: The RBI on debit and credit cards
events.note: The RBI's Payment System Report (December 2025) on why debit-card payments fell.
events.quote: the decline in debit card transactions, both in volume and value, is potentially driven by the rise of digital wallets, UPI, and credit card adoption
